title: Buyer beware!
text: Buyer beware!. Caution read every review!!! Piece of crap! Seriously. I have purchased a lot of things through the years from Amazon and this was the biggest disappointment ever! This is a really nice looking trash can but that’s it! I failed to read every review before purchasing. My biggest mistake! The sensor does not work!  It opens an inch. Press the button it still opens an inch! I need to grip the edge to pull it up. I don’t care but the lid then remains open for a few minutes. I would keep this can if the open button worked but it doesn’t!  I have to grip a little edge of the can to open it!!! It’s a nightmare. I suggest reading every review and using caution when buying. I think many of these cans sold are defective!!! It’s too bad. It’s actually a nice looking slim can but I’m not wasting my money on defective crappy merchandise. Buyer beware the sensor and button do not work to open some of these units.
